weapons.why: Dungeon flail requiring Skeletron to access the Locked Gold Chests.

weapons.name: Sunfury

weapons.why: Underworld Shadow Chest flail from the Hellstone tier.

weapons.name: Dark Lance
weapons.source: Found in Underworld Shadow Chests (Shadow Key) and Obsidian Lock Boxes
weapons.why: Underworld Shadow Chest spear opened with a Dungeon-found Shadow Key.

weapons.name: Muramasa
weapons.source: Found in Dungeon Locked Gold Chests
weapons.why: Fast broadsword found in the Dungeon after Skeletron.

weapons.name: Obsidian Swordfish
weapons.source: Fished in lava (lava fishing in the Underworld)
weapons.why: Lava-fished spear that also fires piercing embers on thrust.

weapons.name: Valor
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Gold Chests (requires Skeletron for access)
weapons.why: Dungeon Gold Chest yoyo requiring Skeletron for access.

weapons.name: Hive-Five
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Crafted from Queen Bee's Bee Wax and releases homing bee projectiles.

weapons.name: Flamarang
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Hellstone-tier boomerang that inflicts On Fire.

weapons.name: Cascade
weapons.source: Dropped by Underworld enemies after Skeletron is defeated (pre-Hardmode only)
weapons.why: Post-Skeletron Underworld drop that can inflict On Fire!.

weapons.why: Group of nine identical broadswords; can be thrown while swinging.

weapons.source: Found in Skyware Chests (Floating Islands)

weapons.name: Volcano

weapons.why: Creates an explosion on hitting enemies.

weapons.why: Corruption flail obtained by breaking Shadow Orbs, needs no boss.

armor.name: Molten Armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: 10% extra melee damage, immunity to fire blocks, and you cannot be set on fire.
armor.effect: +25 defense · +17% melee damage · +7% melee critical strike chance · +7% melee speed · Immunity to the On Fire! and Burning debuffs

accessories.name: Feral Claws
accessories.source: Found in Jungle chests or Jungle Crates
accessories.why: Increases melee attack speed and grants autoswing to melee weapons.

accessories.name: Magma Stone
accessories.source: Dropped by Hellbats and Lava Bats
accessories.why: Adds fire damage to melee strikes.

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eye of Cthulhu)
accessories.why: Grants a short dash that damages enemies (double-tap a direction).

accessories.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
accessories.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Provides substantial vertical mobility and acceleration.

accessories.name: Terraspark Boots
accessories.source: Combined through the full boots crafting chain
accessories.why: Super-fast running and flight, with lava, water, and honey walking plus ice mobility.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This remains the safest default combat potion for late pre-Hardmode melee.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It makes long boss bridges and Underworld fights more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed is still one of the best ways to improve real fight consistency.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction gets better the scarier the fight becomes, and this phase has the scariest pre-Hardmode one.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Sharpening Station
buffs.source: Found in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle
buffs.why: The armor penetration bonus is one of the best class-specific pre-Hardmode melee boosts.

buffs.name: Ale
buffs.why: Tipsy: more melee damage and crit for less defense.

buffs.name: Flask of Poison
buffs.why: Coats melee hits with the Poisoned debuff.

items.name: Fledgling Wings
items.source: Found in Skyware Chests, Sky Crates, and Azure Crates
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).

items.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
items.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
items.why: Provides substantial vertical mobility and acceleration.

items.name: Ram Rune
items.source: Found in Locked Gold Chests in the Dungeon, and in Golden Lock Boxes from Dungeon Crates or Stockade Crates
items.why: Allows the player to perform a ground-pound, which greatly increases the player's downward mobility and damages nearby enemies.
items.notes: The Ram Rune can be relevant into Hardmode in some niche scenarios if combined with a Gravitation Potion, as it provides high vertical acceleration on par with the Slimy Saddle, but can be used both upwards and downwards.

items.name: Panic Necklace
items.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop and Ecto Mist
items.why: Briefly increases the player's movement speed after they take damage. Can be upgraded into the Stinger Necklace.

items.name: Lightning Boots
items.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
items.why: Sprint and flight movement in one slot, accelerating faster and reaching a higher top speed than Spectre Boots.

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 15%, and their acceleration (and deceleration) by 75%. This movement speed buff no longer applies if the player is not grounded.

items.name: Worm Scarf
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eater of Worlds)
items.why: Reduces all damage taken by 17%.

items.name: Brain of Confusion
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Brain of Cthulhu)
items.why: 16.67% chance to dodge an attack when hit, which grants +10% crit and summon damage for 4s; taking damage also has a 60% chance to confuse nearby enemies.

items.name: Band of Regeneration
items.source: Found in Gold Chests in the Underground and Cavern, and in Living Mahogany Trees in the Underground Jungle
items.why: Increases the player's passive health regeneration by 1 HP/s (which ignores the effects of the Bleeding debuff).

items.name: Honey Comb
items.source: Dropped by Queen Bee (1/3 chance)
items.why: When hit, releases 1-3 bees that attack nearby enemies.

items.name: Obsidian Shield
items.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
items.why: Knockback immunity, fire block immunity and 2 defense.

items.name: Hive Pack
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Queen Bee)
items.why: Increases the damage of friendly bees.

items.name: Bone Helm
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Deerclops)
items.why: Summons Shadow Hand projectiles to damage enemies.

items.name: Bone Glove
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Skeletron)
items.why: Causes crossbone projectiles to be thrown from the player's weapon at a maximum of once every second.

items.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
items.source: Drops from Blood Zombies and Dripplers during a Blood Moon
items.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration. Can be stacked with or upgraded into the Stinger Necklace.
items.notes: The player should use the Shark Tooth Necklace (or its upgrade) if they are unable to consistently damage the Wall of Flesh's eyes, as its mouth has considerably higher defense.

items.name: Strung Counterweight
items.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
items.why: Combines the effects of Yoyo Strings and Counterweights.

items.name: Feral Claws
items.source: Found in Bramble Crate and 2 other sources
items.why: Increases melee speed by 12%.

items.name: Counterweights
items.source: Sold by the Traveling Merchant and the Skeleton Merchant
items.why: Causes yoyos after landing a hit on enemies to produce a "counterweight" projectile, which travels towards the enemy before arcing over the player.

weapons.why: Turns arrows into bats that bounce off surfaces.

weapons.why: Upgrade to the Handgun, with higher damage and fire rate.

weapons.why: Sold by the Arms Dealer in a Graveyard only after Skeletron is defeated.

weapons.name: Handgun
weapons.source: Found in Locked Gold Chests and Golden Lock Boxes in the Dungeon
weapons.why: Pre-Hardmode gun found in the Dungeon, which requires defeating Skeletron.

weapons.name: Molten Fury
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Hellstone-tier bow that ignites the arrows it fires.

weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Fires Fallen Stars for high damage, limited by how many stars you have collected.

weapons.name: The Bee's Knees

weapons.why: Converts wooden arrows into homing bees.

items.name: Shield of Cthulhu
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eye of Cthulhu)
items.why: Grants a short dash that damages enemies (double-tap a direction).

items.name: Fledgling Wings
items.source: Found in Skyware Chests, Sky Crates, and Azure Crates
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).

items.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
items.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
items.why: Provides substantial vertical mobility and acceleration.

items.name: Ram Rune
items.source: Found in Gold Chest (Dungeon) and 1 other source
items.why: Allows the player to perform a ground-pound, which greatly increases the player's downward mobility and damages nearby enemies.
items.notes: The Ram Rune can be relevant into Hardmode in some niche scenarios if combined with a Gravitation Potion, as it provides high vertical acceleration on par with the Slimy Saddle, but can be used both upwards and downwards.

items.name: Balloons
items.why: Combines the effects of an extra jump with balloons and a Lucky Horseshoe.

items.name: Panic Necklace
items.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop and Ecto Mist
items.why: Briefly increases the player's movement speed after they take damage. Can be upgraded into the Stinger Necklace.

items.name: Lightning Boots
items.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
items.why: Sprint and flight movement in one slot, accelerating faster and reaching a higher top speed than Spectre Boots.

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 15%, and their acceleration (and deceleration) by 75%. This movement speed buff no longer applies if the player is not grounded.

items.name: Worm Scarf
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eater of Worlds)
items.why: Reduces all damage taken by 17%.

items.name: Brain of Confusion
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Brain of Cthulhu)
items.why: 16.67% chance to dodge an attack when hit, which grants +10% crit and summon damage for 4s; taking damage also has a 60% chance to confuse nearby enemies.

items.name: Band of Regeneration
items.source: Found in Gold Chests in the Underground and Cavern, and in Living Mahogany Trees in the Underground Jungle
items.why: Increases the player's passive health regeneration by 1 HP/s (which ignores the effects of the Bleeding debuff).

items.name: Honey Comb
items.source: Dropped by Queen Bee and 1 other source
items.why: When the player is hit:

items.name: Obsidian Shield
items.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
items.why: Knockback immunity, fire block immunity and 2 defense.

items.name: Hive Pack
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Queen Bee)
items.why: Increases the damage of friendly bees.

items.name: Bone Helm
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Deerclops)
items.why: Summons Shadow Hand projectiles to damage enemies.

items.name: Bone Glove
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Skeletron)
items.why: Causes crossbone projectiles to be thrown from the player's weapon at a maximum of once every second.

items.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
items.source: Drops from Blood Zombies and Dripplers during a Blood Moon
items.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration. Can be stacked with or upgraded into the Stinger Necklace.
items.notes: The player should use the Shark Tooth Necklace (or its upgrade) if they are unable to consistently damage the Wall of Flesh's eyes, as its mouth has considerably higher defense.

items.name: Apprentice's Scarf
items.source: Dropped by Dark Mage (T1) and 1 other source
items.why: Increases the player's sentry slots by one and buffs overall summon damage by 10%.
items.notes: Players seeking to repeatedly do Old One's Army events, in order to stock up on Defender Medals for future Tier 2 equipment, can find benefit from the Apprentice's Scarf or Squire's Shield, which provide noticeable buffs to sentries.

items.name: Squire's Shield
items.source: Dropped by the Old One’s Army (Eternia Crystal event)
items.why: +1 sentry slot and 10% increased summon damage.
